title: Moving codes with a sign-in check
description: The new phone is ready only after the confirmation methods you need have been tested.

blocks.text: The password can come across successfully while the second step of the sign-in stays on the old device. One message saying it is finished is not enough.

quote.text: Got a new phone and it didn’t transfer any of my codes when I transferred my data from my old phone to new. Now I’m locked out of everything and there’s no back up options.

blocks.text: Show what the move includes and separate actions for unsupported entries. Help test the chosen accounts on the new device.
The fallback path depends on the confirmation method. Do not promise the recovery of every account with one button, or keep a copy without protection that has been thought through.
